volunteer_experience.info: EQUAL is an award winning animal assisted centre in Singapore that develops life ability in youths, people with special needs, families, and seniors. As a groom volunteer at EQUAL, I took care of all the rescue and underprivileged horses at this stable especially the ones gone through trauma or injury. My activities included but were not limited to mucking stalls, walking, and cleaning the horses.
volunteer_experience.subtitle: EQUAL
volunteer_experience.title: Volunteer

projects.title: BetterDorm/CampusNest
projects.description: Won a SpartUp hackathon by Cisco/SJSU, placing 1st within 300+ people, gaining a 4 figure prize. Built a full-stack housing platform during a hackathon using TypeScript, Node.js, and Express, deployed with Docker containers on AWS ECS. The platform successfully served over 1,000 users from more than 10 colleges. I developed roommate-matching algorithms and integrated real-time chatbot services using Socket.io and JWT authentication, handling over 1,000 messages. These features significantly enhanced the user experience, improving match satisfaction by 85%.

projects.title: RepoAI
projects.description: Developed an open-source platform that provides modular AI tools such as text summarization and sentiment analysis, built with a FastAPI backend and React frontend. The platform features a secure RESTful API with JWT-based authentication, ensuring safe user access. Additionally, I designed a flexible plugin system that allows users to contribute and integrate their own AI tools, promoting community-driven development and extensibility.

projects.title: Car Scraper Application
projects.description: Built a car information scraper application with BeautifulSoup4. Scraped car data from a variety of websites including Carvana, Hemmings, Autotrader, and Auto List.Worked with changing HTTP headers and simulating requests in browsers to avoid bot detection and bypass captchas.Analyzed and extracted car data, saving it in a structured format which was then uploaded to a database using a Python MongoDB driver.

organizations.title: Atoms Academy
organizations.description: As a player associated with Singapore Polo Club, I am currently in the ATOMS academy, qualified to play tournament matches and chukkas ranked at Elite.

organizations.title: PAW
organizations.description: PAW is a service club dedicated to helping animals and protecting animal rights all over the world. At our weekly meetings members can help with activities such as preparing for events, making social media posts, shelter visits, and much more for the cause overall.

organizations.title: Monta Vista Bhangra
organizations.description: As a member of Monta Vista Bhangra, I frequently attended weekly practices, submitting videos, and strived to become better daily with my dancing. At the time of me leaving the school and therefore the club, I was recognized as a key figure of the team, and offered a chance at leadership of the team.

organizations.title: South Bay Polo
organizations.description: At South Bay Polo, I found my love and passion for Horse Polo. I was a frequent member of the club, constantly playing in games and chukkas every week, having to tack up the horses before we played and clean them after the games. I developed different skills from playing at the club, including teamwork, discipline, and hard-work to get better not only as a person, but also as a player.

organizations.title: United States Polo Association
organizations.description: As a member of South Bay Polo Club, which is affiliated with USPA, I was a member for 2 years before moving to another club associated with the HPA.

organizations.title: Monta Vista CS Club
organizations.description: At Monta Vista CS Club, we strived to learn and apply innovative and creative technologies to various projects. Unfortunately, we faced the problems of COVID, and were then confronted with team-based challenges throughout the year, hard-work and collaboration in order to complete tasks during the pandemic.
